CORE MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 12x

2. Solve for x: x + 7 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 6
   D. 13

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

5. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 64
   C. 8
   D. 9

6. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 56
   C. 57
   D. 15

7. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 24
   D. 2

8. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

9. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 44
   C. 105
   D. 30

10. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

11. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x = 5
   B. x ≥ 0 only
   C. x > 5
   D. x < 5

12. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19
   C. 19.6
   D. 19.7

13. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 37
   C. 31.6
   D. 31

14. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 4

15. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 33
   C. 4
   D. 32

16. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

17. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 77
   C. 36
   D. 22

19. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 8 cm and 15 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 19
   C. 7
   D. 23

20. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 26
   C. 25
   D. 10

22. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 7

23. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 40

24. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 82

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
